Every nonzero product exponent is bounded by the sum of the two row maxima minus254. When the original carried exponent is at least that bound and is within the validated scalar scale range,the original K16 maximum equals the carried exponent. This certificate removes per-product exponent extraction and the subgroup maximum reduction and makes carry alignment the identity.

A declined certificate retains the original prevalidated float reduction. An ineligible original row uses the complete original integer dot in the production path. All K16 ordering,modulo sign resolution,canonical normalization,negative-zero behavior and final BF16 endpoints are preserved.
